segments.he:
תּוֹרָה רכח
כְּשֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מִסְתַּכֵּל בַּנְּשָׁמָה שֶׁתּוּכַל לְהַחֲזִיר בְּנֵי אָדָם בִּתְשׁוּבָה וְלַעֲשׂוֹת גֵּרִים, אָז הוּא יִתְבָּרַךְ בְּעַצְמוֹ כִּבְיָכוֹל מְבַקֵּשׁ וְרוֹאֶה שֶׁיִּהְיֶה מַחֲלֹקֶת עָלֶיהָ:
segments.en: And one must ask greatly from Hashem Yisborach to merit to draw close to the true Tzadik. For fortunate is one who merits to draw close to him while still alive. Fortunate is he — fortunate is his portion. And the accuser focuses greatly on this — to confuse the world. For Israel are now very close to the End — and they now have longings and yearnings for Hashem Yisborach — the like of which has not existed in former times. And therefore the accuser has cunningly set up many false famous ones in the world. And also among the true Tzadikim — he has introduced conflict — until no one knows where the truth is. Therefore one must ask greatly from Hashem Yisborach to merit to draw close to the true Tzadik.
